Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 4

“Children speak of Sankhya and Yoga as distinct, but not the learned. One who is properly established in either obtains the fruit of both.”

A sharp word — children — for a distinction Arjuna has pressed for two chapters. Krishna calls the split a beginner's misreading rather than a real fork in the road.
